title: Fallback to serial read_csv on bare carriage returns before data start
answers: Why does parallel read_csv drop or corrupt the first row with bare carriage returns in the header?
Why does read_csv fall back from parallel to serial execution on CSV files with bare CR?
How does parallel read_csv validate line endings before chunking?
body:
Symptom: parallel read_csv silently drops the first data row or adds an extra junk first row when headers contain bare carriage returns.
Root cause: pandas/io/parsers/readers.py:_read_csv_chunks counted lines using readline() expecting 
, but the C tokenizer also ends lines on bare , miscalculating data_start.
Fix pattern: Inspect pre-data bytes for bare  by stripping 
 and checking for , returning None to fall back to serial parsing.
Constraints: Applies to preamble and first data line checks in parallel read_csv; files with standard 
 (CRLF) or 
 (LF) remain on the parallel path.
